record_type_quote: In 20 independent experiments, human basophils were treated with highly diluted histamine (15cH, 16cH, corresponding to 10-30-10-32 M) prior to activation by fMLP (formyl-methionyl-leucyl-phenylalanine peptide).

targets.title: Improvement of flow cytometric analysis of basophil activation inhibition by high histamine dilutions. A novel basophil specific marker: CD 203c.
targets.evidence_quote: We aimed at performing an independent replication of a former study [1] using rigorously controlled experimental conditions to minimise confounding factors.
targets.outcome_quote: Though we strictly adopted the experimental procedure described in [1], our results do not confirm the large inhibitory effects observed for histamine 15cH and 16cH.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly do not confirm the original inhibitory effects; changed blinding and randomization do not erase this verdict.
